workflows.name: Lark Bitable + Project Management Automation (in Chinese)
workflows.desc: A case study in automating software-project management with Lark Bitable: agents can report bugs and automatically scan and analyze them. It also demonstrates automatic subagent delegation.

workflows.name: Tmall Supermarket Product Batch Scraper (in Chinese)
workflows.desc: Demonstrates scraping information for a product category from Tmall Supermarket, automatically downloading product images, and saving the results to an Excel file in bulk.

workflows.name: GitHub Trending AI Project Tracker (in Chinese)
workflows.desc: Demonstrates weekly scheduled tracking of GitHub Trending's weekly and monthly rankings, generating an analysis report on popular AI projects, and sending a Lark message.

workflows.name: Batch Courseware Creation from Textbooks (in Chinese)
workflows.desc: Demonstrates using a specified PDF textbook to batch-generate presentation slides, instructional-design tables, and learning task sheets for each course unit. It also demonstrates two methods for batch launching subagents.
